environment: local container; real Git 2.47.3, ephemeral bare remote, three independent clones and four separate-process logical identities

case_results.evidence: Two subprocesses read eligible tasks from own clones; same git email, distinct four-field actor
Simultaneous competing Git ref CAS one winner, one loser; stale clone rejected
Worker rejects task start with foreign actor even when claim token is provided
Regression for corrected owner equality check on claim release
Real event/checkpoint output and scoped Git commit, remote blob readback and provenance trailer
Cold separate-clone process resumes, deterministic distinct reviewer records PASS; producer refreshes and completes run
Simulated stopped process, remote expiry, blocked implicit takeover, audited reclaim and stale-token rejection
Induced remote loss fails closed and prevents worker artifact submission
Divergent histories refuse unsafe refresh; local modified source preserved
Independent parallel child runs, explicit backup/reconciliation, reviews, exact checked output hashes and merged synthetic summary
Migrated paused child run to different local Git bare remote; state persisted, claim refs not silently inherited

local_result.run_configuration: 9 tests in first group (25.252 s) and 2 tests in second group (16.943 s); each with isolated test fixture

discovered_defect: GitClient.release accepted mismatched recorded actor when token/epoch valid; corrected with actor equality check and new regression case
limitations: Logical identities self-declared, no authenticated owner authority, simulated lease expiry, no external API fencing, distinct processes are not different AI platforms
